raw_definitions: Definisi : n kubu, kota; hold the ~, ( colloq ) menjaga + approp n: Mr Gopi asked his assistant to hold the ~ while he took the day’s takings to the bank, Encik Gopi meminta pembantunya menjaga kedai sementara dia menghantar pendapatan hari itu ke bank. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
